official.title: Seasonal Climate Outlook
official.english_core_text: However, the probabilistic forecast suggests a moderate to high probability of above-normal rainfall in most areas of western and northern Luzon, while a moderate probability of below normal is expected over most parts of the Visayas and northern Mindanao. El Niño increases the likelihood of below-normal rainfall conditions , which may lead to dry spells and droughts in some parts of the country. The SW monsoon is expected to persist during this period, bringing widespread and heavy rainfall to the western sections of Luzon and the Visayas. The rainfall forecast indicates generally near-normal rainfall conditions over most parts of the country, with above-normal rainfall expected in some areas of western Northern Luzon.

official.title: Monthly Climate Assessment and Outlook
official.english_core_text: Based on observed rainfall during the past months and the forecast for August, meteorological drought/dry spells are likely to be experienced by the end of the month in some areas of Bicol Region, Eastern Visayas, and Negros Island Region. El Niño increases the likelihood of below-normal rainfall, which may lead to adverse impacts, including dry spells and droughts in some areas of the country. In addition, nineteen (19) provinces experienced meteorological drought, most of which were in Luzon; two (2) provinces were under dry spells, and three (3) provinces experienced dry conditions. The rainfall forecast for August suggests that above-normal rainfall conditions will be experienced over the western parts of Northern and Central Luzon, and patches of below- normal rainfall are likely over the Bicol Region, Visayas, Caraga, and Zamboanga Peninsula, while near-normal conditions are expected over the rest of the country.
